create_UpdateGenericHook_with_update_fun: create an UpdateGenericHook that runs a custom update function when a dataclass field changes
create_UpdateGenericHook_with_condition: create an UpdateGenericHook with a conditional check that only triggers the update function when a predicate is true
create_UpdateGenericHook_trigger_on_all: create an UpdateGenericHook with only_trigger_on_change set to false so it fires on every hook event
create_UpdateGenericHook_custom_triggers: create an UpdateGenericHook that triggers only on specific HookEventType events like PRE_INIT or POST_DELETE
run_UpdateGenericHook_on_field_change: run an UpdateGenericHook by changing a field on a dataclass instance that uses DataclassHookMixin
